accommodation.name: St Christopher's Inn Paris - Gare du Nord
accommodation.notes: Social hostel near Canal de l'Ourcq and Bassin de la Villette. Metro: Crimée (Line 7) or Laumière (Line 5). Direct Line 5 to Quai de Bercy bus station (15 min). Close to Canal Saint-Martin area. Hostel has bar, common areas, and social events. ~25-30 min to central Paris attractions.

arrival.notes: Flight arrives 10:35 at Orly. Take Orlybus to Denfert-Rochereau (€9.50, ~30 min), then Metro Line 4 to Gare du Nord, transfer to Line 5 to Laumière (total ~40 min metro). OR: RER B to Gare du Nord, walk 15 min to hostel. Total transit: 60-75 min. Estimated hostel arrival: 11:45-12:30.

departure.notes: FlixBus departs 06:30 from Quai de Bercy, arrives Bruges 11:10 (4h 40m, no transfers). Metro Line 5 from Laumière to Quai de la Gare (direct, 15 min). Allow 45 min from hostel to bus station. MUCH easier than from Madrigal.

days.title: Royal Gardens, Grand Bridges & Eiffel Tower

timeBlocks.name: morning
timeBlocks.description: Royal Paris: Tuileries, Hôtel de la Marine, Pont Alexandre III (CORE OPTIONS)

activities.name: Jardin des Tuileries
activities.notes: Historic royal garden between Louvre and Place de la Concorde. Morning stroll before crowds.

activities.name: Hôtel de la Marine
activities.notes: Stunning 18th-century palace with 3D audio guides. Paris Museum Pass INCLUDED. Timed entry reservation REQUIRED.

activities.name: Pont Alexandre III
activities.notes: Paris's most ornate bridge with gilded statues and Art Nouveau lamps. Featured in Midnight in Paris.

timeBlocks.name: lunch
timeBlocks.description: Lunch near Invalides or Rue Cler market street

activities.name: Lunch at Rue Cler or nearby bistro
activities.notes: Rue Cler is a famous pedestrian market street with cafés and food shops. Great for a casual lunch.

timeBlocks.name: afternoon
timeBlocks.description: Les Invalides, Eiffel Tower, Trocadéro (CORE OPTIONS)

activities.name: Les Invalides & Musée de l'Armée
activities.notes: Napoleon's tomb and extensive military museum. Paris Museum Pass INCLUDED. Reservation recommended.

activities.name: Champ de Mars
activities.notes: Large public greenspace at the base of the Eiffel Tower. Perfect for picnic or rest.

activities.name: Eiffel Tower
activities.notes: BOOK WEEKS IN ADVANCE. NOT covered by Museum Pass. Elevator to summit: €29.40. Stairs to 2nd floor + elevator to summit: €22.60.

timeBlocks.name: evening
timeBlocks.description: Trocadéro sunset views, Arc de Triomphe (CORE OPTIONS)

activities.name: Trocadéro
activities.notes: Best frontal view of the Eiffel Tower, especially at sunset. Watch the tower sparkle on the hour after dark.

activities.name: Arc de Triomphe
activities.notes: Climb to rooftop for 360° panoramic views. Paris Museum Pass INCLUDED. Reservation recommended.

timeBlocks.name: night
timeBlocks.description: Optional: Musée d'Orsay late opening (Thursday) or dinner cruise

activities.name: Musée d'Orsay (Optional - Thursday Late Opening)
activities.notes: Impressionist masterpieces (Monet, Van Gogh, Renoir). Paris Museum Pass INCLUDED. Check if Oct 18, 2026 is a Thursday. Reservation REQUIRED.

alternatives.name: Musée de l'Orangerie
alternatives.reason_considered: Monet's Water Lilies in oval rooms. Museum Pass included.
alternatives.notes: Excellent option if time permits in morning (Tuileries Gardens). 60-90 min visit.

alternatives.name: Champs-Élysées walk
alternatives.reason_considered: Famous avenue from Arc de Triomphe
alternatives.notes: Can walk down from Arc if energy permits, though crowded and touristy.

alternatives.name: Bateaux Mouches dinner cruise
alternatives.reason_considered: Seine river cruise with meal and live music
alternatives.notes: €70-100+ per person. Romantic option but adds significant cost. Not prioritized.

alternatives.name: Musée du Quai Branly
alternatives.reason_considered: Non-European art museum, Museum Pass included
alternatives.notes: Near Eiffel Tower but would require cutting Invalides short.

research_notes.notes: Saturday. Full day focused on iconic Paris monuments and river views. Eiffel Tower reservation is CRITICAL and should be booked as early as possible. Museum Pass covers most entries.

days.title: Louvre Masterpieces, Historic Islands & Le Marais

activities.name: Musée du Louvre - Carrousel Entrance
activities.notes: ENTER via Carrousel du Louvre to skip pyramid lines. Paris Museum Pass INCLUDED. Timed entry REQUIRED. Focus on: Ala Denon (Mona Lisa, Winged Victory, Liberty Leading the People, Coronation of Napoleon, Wedding at Cana), Ala Sully (Venus de Milo, Sphinx of Tanis, Egyptian mummies, Lamassu), Ala Richelieu (Galerie d'Apollon, Napoleon III Apartments).

secondaryPlaces.name: Ala Denon - Mona Lisa & Winged Victory
secondaryPlaces.notes: Most famous works. Arrive early to Mona Lisa room to avoid peak crowds.

secondaryPlaces.name: Ala Sully - Venus de Milo & Egyptian Antiquities
secondaryPlaces.notes: Greek statues and extensive Egyptian collection.

timeBlocks.name: lunch
timeBlocks.description: Lunch near Latin Quarter or Île de la Cité

activities.name: Lunch in Latin Quarter or Le Marais
activities.notes: Casual French bistro or crêperie. Latin Quarter has many student-friendly options.

timeBlocks.name: afternoon
timeBlocks.description: Île de la Cité, Notre-Dame, Sainte-Chapelle, Latin Quarter (CORE OPTIONS)

activities.name: Île de la Cité & Place Dauphine
activities.notes: Historic island heart of Paris. Charming tree-lined square with cafés.

activities.name: Cathédrale Notre-Dame de Paris
activities.notes: Under reconstruction after 2019 fire. Exterior viewing and square accessible. Check if interior has reopened by Oct 2026. Reservation required if interior open.

bookingDetails.advanceTimeNeeded: Check official site for reopening status and booking

activities.name: Sainte-Chapelle
activities.notes: Stunning 13th-century Gothic chapel with floor-to-ceiling stained glass. Paris Museum Pass INCLUDED. Timed entry REQUIRED. Security line can be long.

activities.name: Panthéon
activities.notes: Neoclassical mausoleum of France's greatest citizens (Rousseau, Voltaire, Victor Hugo, Marie Curie). Paris Museum Pass INCLUDED. Reservation recommended.

timeBlocks.name: evening
timeBlocks.description: Le Marais neighborhood, Place des Vosges, dinner (CORE OPTIONS)

activities.name: Centre Pompidou (Exterior)
activities.notes: Iconic inside-out modern architecture. Exterior walk-by. Museum interior and rooftop terrace are Museum Pass INCLUDED if time permits.
activities.cost: Free exterior / Museum Pass for interior

activities.name: L'As du Fallafel
activities.notes: Famous falafel sandwich on Rue des Rosiers in Le Marais. Expect long lines but fast service. Check day of week.

activities.name: Place des Vosges & Maison de Victor Hugo
activities.notes: Oldest planned square in Paris (1612). Elegant red-brick arcades. Victor Hugo's former residence museum is Museum Pass INCLUDED but likely closed by evening.
activities.cost: Free square / Museum Pass for museum

alternatives.name: La Conciergerie
alternatives.reason_considered: Former royal palace and Marie Antoinette's prison cell. Museum Pass included.
alternatives.notes: On Île de la Cité. Can combine with Sainte-Chapelle (often sold as combo ticket). 60 min visit.

alternatives.name: Musée de Cluny (Medieval Museum)
alternatives.reason_considered: Medieval art including Lady and the Unicorn tapestries. Museum Pass included.
alternatives.notes: In Latin Quarter. 90 min visit. Would fit after Panthéon.

alternatives.name: Jardin du Luxembourg
alternatives.reason_considered: Beautiful palace gardens with fountain and chairs
alternatives.notes: Free. Near Panthéon. Could add 30-45 min stroll if time permits.

alternatives.name: Musée Carnavalet
alternatives.reason_considered: Paris history museum in Le Marais. Free permanent collection.
alternatives.notes: Free entry. 90-120 min. Could visit if skipping Pompidou interior.

alternatives.name: Musée Picasso
alternatives.reason_considered: Largest Picasso collection. Museum Pass included.
alternatives.notes: In Le Marais. 90-120 min. Reservation required. Better for Day 4 or 5.

research_notes.notes: Sunday. Louvre is the highlight - dedicate full morning. Afternoon focuses on Île de la Cité and Latin Quarter. Evening in Le Marais. Very full day with extensive walking.

activities.name: Petit Palais
activities.notes: Permanent collection of fine arts is FREE. Temporary exhibits may charge fee. Beautiful interior courtyard garden.

activities.name: Palais Garnier (Opéra Garnier)
activities.timeRestriction: Open 10:00-17:00 daily (closes earlier on performance days)
activities.notes: Opulent 19th-century opera house (Phantom of the Opera setting). NOT covered by Museum Pass. Self-guided tour. Reservation recommended.

activities.name: Passage des Panoramas
activities.notes: One of Paris's oldest covered shopping arcades (1800). Charming glass-roofed passage with boutiques and cafés.

timeBlocks.name: lunch
timeBlocks.description: Lunch near Montmartre base or Pigalle

activities.name: Lunch near Montmartre
activities.notes: Casual bistro before climbing Montmartre hill. Rue des Abbesses area has good options.

timeBlocks.name: afternoon
timeBlocks.description: Montmartre hill, Sacré-Cœur, artistic squares (CORE OPTIONS)

activities.name: Rue des Abbesses & Montmartre Streets
activities.notes: Charming village-like streets at the base of Montmartre. Art Nouveau metro entrance.

activities.name: Villa Léandre
activities.notes: Hidden cobblestone cul-de-sac with English-style cottages. Very photogenic.

activities.name: Place Dalida
activities.notes: Small square with bust of French-Italian singer Dalida. Nice views over Paris.

activities.name: Basilique du Sacré-Cœur
activities.notes: White Romano-Byzantine basilica on Montmartre hilltop. FREE entry to basilica. Dome climb is €7 (NOT Museum Pass). Panoramic views. Note: STEEP hill climb or funicular (metro ticket).

activities.name: Place du Tertre
activities.notes: Historic artists' square. Very touristy but iconic. Street artists paint portraits and caricatures.

activities.name: Père-Lachaise Cemetery
activities.notes: World's most visited cemetery. Graves of Jim Morrison, Oscar Wilde, Edith Piaf, Chopin, Molière. FREE entry. Bring cemetery map or use app. Check closing time for October.

activities.name: Dinner near Père-Lachaise or return to hotel area
activities.notes: Casual dinner in Ménilmontant/Oberkampf area or return to Montparnasse neighborhood.

alternatives.name: Studio 28 (Historic Cinema)
alternatives.reason_considered: Oldest cinema in Paris (1928). Charming art house theater in Montmartre.
alternatives.notes: Could catch a film if interested. Check showtimes.

alternatives.name: Moulin de la Galette & La Maison Rose
alternatives.reason_considered: Historic windmill and pink café painted by Impressionists
alternatives.notes: On the Montmartre walk route. Quick photo stops.

alternatives.name: Le Pure Café (Before Sunset film location)
alternatives.reason_considered: Café featured in Before Sunset film
alternatives.notes: Near Père-Lachaise. Could stop for coffee or aperitif.

alternatives.name: Cour de l'Étoile-d'Or (Before Sunset film location)
alternatives.reason_considered: Courtyard from Celine's apartment in Before Sunset

research_notes.notes: Monday. Montmartre requires significant hill climbing - consider fitness level. Funicular (metro ticket) can help. Père-Lachaise is far east, so factor in metro transit time (~30 min from Montmartre).

must_try_dishes.description: Buttery, flaky crescent-shaped pastry. Best eaten fresh in the morning from a boulangerie.
Flaky pastry with dark chocolate batons inside.
Simple but perfect: fresh baguette with quality ham and butter. The quintessential French lunch.
Thin pancakes, sweet or savory. Popular street food and casual meal.
Classic French bistro dish. Beef steak with crispy fries and simple sauce.
Traditional Burgundy dish: chicken slow-cooked in red wine with mushrooms, bacon, onions.
Snails cooked in garlic-parsley butter. A French classic.
Rich beef broth with caramelized onions, topped with toasted bread and melted Gruyère cheese.
Creamy vanilla custard with hard caramelized sugar top that cracks when tapped.
Delicate almond meringue sandwich cookies with ganache filling. Parisian specialty.
Classic French dessert: apples caramelized in butter and sugar, baked with pastry on top, then flipped.

drinks_and_rituals.description: French coffee culture. 'Un café' is espresso. 'Café crème' or 'café au lait' has milk. Typically enjoyed standing at the bar or sitting at a café.
French wine culture is integral. Order by glass (verre) or bottle. House wine (vin de maison) is usually good quality and affordable.
French ritual of having a light alcoholic drink before dinner to stimulate appetite. Kir (white wine + crème de cassis), Pastis (anise liqueur), or Champagne.
Thick, rich hot chocolate. Parisian hot chocolate is luxurious, almost like melted chocolate.

restaurants.name: L'As du Fallafel
restaurants.notes: Famous falafel on Rue des Rosiers. Long lines but fast service. Closed Friday evening & Saturday (Sabbath).

restaurants.name: Paul (Bakery chain)
restaurants.notes: Reliable chain for quick breakfast or lunch. Good quality pastries and sandwiches.

restaurants.name: La Maison d'Isabelle
restaurants.notes: Featured in Alan's guide as having the best croissant in Paris. Small bakery, expect lines.

restaurants.name: Café Marly (Louvre)
restaurants.notes: Elegant café inside Louvre courtyard. Pricey but iconic location.

special_meal_formats.name: Formule / Menu du jour
special_meal_formats.description: Fixed-price lunch menu (usually 2 or 3 courses) offered at many bistros. Excellent value and authentic experience.

special_meal_formats.name: Boulangerie breakfast
special_meal_formats.description: Buy fresh croissants and pain au chocolat from a local bakery, eat in a park or by the Seine.

special_meal_formats.name: Picnic from Monoprix
special_meal_formats.description: Buy cheese, bread, charcuterie, wine from supermarket (Monoprix, Franprix) and picnic in Luxembourg Gardens, Champ de Mars, or along Canal Saint-Martin.

tourist_traps_to_avoid: Avoid restaurants with large picture menus in multiple languages near major monuments (Eiffel Tower, Notre-Dame, Champs-Élysées). They're overpriced and low quality.
Skip chain restaurants on Champs-Élysées - extremely expensive and touristy.
Don't pay for bottled water at cafés unless necessary - tap water (une carafe d'eau) is free and safe.
Avoid eating on Place du Tertre in Montmartre - very overpriced. Walk 2 blocks away for better value.

ticket_types.name: t+ ticket (single journey)
ticket_types.validity: Valid for metro, bus, tram for 90 min (no round-trips, one-way only)
ticket_types.notes: Buy at metro stations, vending machines, or tabacs. Can buy carnet of 10 for €17.35.

ticket_types.name: Navigo Découverte (weekly pass)
ticket_types.validity: Monday-Sunday unlimited travel in selected zones
ticket_types.notes: Best value if staying 3+ days. Requires passport photo. Covers airport transport too (Orly, CDG).

ticket_types.name: Paris Visite (tourist pass)
ticket_types.notes: More expensive than Navigo. Only worthwhile if arriving mid-week and needing airport transfers.

ticket_types.name: Orlybus
ticket_types.validity: One-way from Orly Airport to Denfert-Rochereau
ticket_types.notes: Direct bus, 30 min journey, runs every 10-20 min.

where_to_buy.tabac_shops: Tobacco shops sell single tickets and carnets
where_to_buy.online: Navigo pass can be loaded via app

operating_hours.notes: Check RATP website or app for real-time schedules

velib_metropole.cost: €1 for 24h or €8 for 7 days (plus usage fees per 30 min)
velib_metropole.notes: Paris bike-share system. Requires credit card with chip. Stations throughout city. Mechanical (green) and electric (blue) bikes available. Electric bikes recommended for Montmartre hill.

tourist_bike_shops.notes: Traditional bike rental if Vélib' system doesn't work for tourists. Check if hotel has partnerships.

emergency_contacts.english_speaking_police: Tourist Police at 72-76 Rue de Lutèce, 75004 (near Notre-Dame)

practical_tips: Buy Paris Museum Pass (€85 for 4 days) ASAP and book all timed entries online immediately.
Book Eiffel Tower tickets 2-4 weeks ahead (NOT covered by Museum Pass).
Metro Line 4 connects hotel to Gare du Nord directly (important for Brussels departure logistics if plans change).
Most museums closed on Mondays or Tuesdays - check before planning.
Restaurants expect you to ask for the bill (l'addition) - it won't come automatically.
Tipping: Service included in bill. Rounding up or leaving €1-2 per person is polite but optional.
Many smaller shops and cafés prefer cash. Carry €20-50 in cash daily.
Free public toilets are rare. Use cafés/museums (often need to purchase something).

alternatives_considered.name: Versailles
alternatives_considered.reason_not_selected: Only 4 full days in Paris (one is departure day at 06:30). Versailles requires half-day minimum. Prioritized central Paris landmarks.

alternatives_considered.name: Musée Rodin
alternatives_considered.reason_not_selected: Beautiful sculpture museum and gardens (Museum Pass included), but itinerary already full. Could swap with Petit Palais on Day 4.

alternatives_considered.name: Catacombs
alternatives_considered.reason_not_selected: Requires advance reservation weeks ahead and NOT covered by Museum Pass. Time-intensive with long underground walk.

alternatives_considered.name: Latin Quarter literary walk
alternatives_considered.reason_not_selected: Day 5 departure at 06:30 makes morning sightseeing impossible.

alternatives_considered.name: Dinner cruise (Bateaux Mouches)
alternatives_considered.reason_not_selected: €70-100+ per person. Romantic but adds significant cost. Not prioritized for solo/budget traveler.

research_notes.notes: Itinerary structured around Paris Museum Pass to maximize value (€85 covers 15+ planned entries worth €200+). Eiffel Tower is NOT covered by pass and requires separate advance booking. Day 5 is departure-only (06:30 bus). Actual sightseeing days: 3.5 days (Day 1 afternoon arrival, Days 2-4 full, Day 5 early departure). Focus on walking/metro/bike mobility from Hôtel Madrigal base near Montparnasse.
